A [[Quarren]] '''pirate''' served as a member of [[Silvo's pirates|Captain Brutus' crew]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="SC 106" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SCDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> the [[pirate]] traveled to the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]] alongside several companions to capture<ref name="SC 106" /> the runaway [[prison]]er<ref name="SC 103">{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}}</ref> [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]],<ref name="SC 106" /> a former leader of their gang.<ref name="SC 106" /> After some pirates failed to catch Silvo as he infiltrated a [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa|local hotel]]'s underground to locate [[Captain Rennod's Lair]],<ref name="SC 105">{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}}</ref> Silvo suddenly emerged from a ground-embedded access hatch on the landing platform just as the pirates were arresting some<ref name="SC 106" /> Lanupan<ref name="SC 105 AD">{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} {{AD|Disney+}}</ref> [[security officer]]s. After pleading with Gunter not to take him, Silvo attempted to enlist [[SM-33]]'s help, but the [[droid]] was quickly disabled with an [[ion rifle]]. As Silvo was escorted to the [[Unidentified pirate transport 1|transport]], the Quarren pirate spotted an incoming [[New Republic]] [[squadron]] of [[X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] and alerted the Captain, who immediately ordered a retreat. As the pirates tried to evade enemy starfighter fire in the [[Atmosphere|air]], [[Unidentified pirate transport 2|one]] pirate vessel was destroyed, but the other—despite sustaining partial damage—managed to escape and return to the [[Silvo's pirate frigate|pirate frigate]].<ref name="SC 106" />

The pirate was an [[Color|orange]]-skinned Quarren, a species known for their prominent facial [[Limb|tentacles]] and two long protrusions extending from either side of their faces,<ref name="SC 106" /> with deep turquoise [[eye]]s and [[Limb|hand]] capped with finned fingers.<ref name="Quarren">{{Databank|quarren|Quarren}}</ref> The individual wore a long, dark-colored [[Clothing|coat]] with matching trousers and a belt cinching the waist. The pirate was equipped with a [[blaster rifle]].<ref name="SC 106" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Quarren]] [[pirate]] debuted in "[[Zero Friends Again]]," the sixth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 106" /> which was aired on [[December 31]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref>
